pages.text: “Resilient and unwavering, swaying with the wind, carrying a hidden power of protection.”$(br2)Oenothera Tea is a calming and protective beverage made from dried oenothera flowers and sugar. The tea is a delicate pink hue with a gentle taste. Drinking it provides a Resistance boost, making travelers more durable in combat.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare Oenothera Tea, $(br)boil dried oenothera flowers with sugar.$(br)It is best consumed before battles or dangerous explorations, enhancing defense and reducing damage taken.

Upon drinking Oenothera Tea, travelers gain a Resistance boost, reducing incoming damage.$(br)This tea is ideal for combat preparation, providing enhanced durability.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
